report.summary: payments-api experienced high p99 latency starting at 13:20 due to cascading latency from ledger-service and ledger-db, caused by the full rollout of the ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag at 13:18.

ranked_hypotheses.title: ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag rollout overloaded ledger-db and ledger-service

supporting.note: ledger.reconciliation_v2 rolled out from 10% to 100% at 13:18, right before latency spike
ledger-db latency spiked at 13:19, reaching over 3.4s
ledger-db CPU spiked to 94.84% starting at 13:19
payments-api p99 latency anomaly began at 13:20, jumping to ~3.3s

ranked_hypotheses.title: TLS deprecation warnings in payments-api caused performance degradation

contradicting.note: TLS deprecation warnings were present continuously since 12:00 when latency was normal
Latency anomaly started at 13:20, well after the constant presence of TLS warnings

facts.text: payments-api p99 latency anomaly started at 2026-10-11T13:20:00+00:00, jumping to over 3.3s.
ledger.reconciliation_v2 rollout changed from 10% to 100% at 2026-10-11T13:18:00+00:00.
ledger-db CPU and p99 latency spiked upward starting at 2026-10-11T13:19:00+00:00.
payments-api makes synchronous dependency calls to ledger-service.
TLS deprecation warnings for legacy-psp occurred consistently throughout the investigation window.

assumptions: The ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag introduced inefficient or resource-intensive queries that saturated ledger-db CPU.
evidence_gaps: Certain log shards experienced query timeouts during deep inspection of ledger-service logs.

timeline.event: Telemetry tracking begins; TLS warnings present in payments-api
ledger-db CPU and p99 latency spike significantly
payments-api error rate begins to rise

recommended_actions.action: Toggle the ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag back to 10% or OFF
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly mitigates the ledger-db CPU saturation and restores p99 latency across ledger and payments services.

recommended_actions.action: Optimize reconciliation_v2 database queries and indexing on ledger-db
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents database CPU exhaustion when reconciliation_v2 is eventually re-enabled.

recommended_actions.action: Clean up legacy TLS client config warnings to reduce noise in logs
recommended_actions.rationale: Eliminates warning log spam that misleads responders during incident triage.
